title: bot.ability.cognition.input
description: InputData payload for the cognition. Bot supplies the stimulus, abilities, named HSM instances, and focus name; the cognition builds tools from snapshots. Selected events are dispatched by Processing.

focus.description: Instance name the bot is looking at, if any.
focus.title: Focus

focus_candidates.description: Instance names that may become focus for this turn (body attention policy).
focus_candidates.title: Focus Candidates

turn.description: The body's processing turn this event belongs to, counted from 1: present on the body's input to the cognition, absent on an ability's handoff of a stimulus to the body [floppy field].

stimulus.description: The event the body took for this turn, as an envelope: its name, its data, and optionally its id, source and target [floppy field].

choices.description: The turn's choices the body assembled: its own (bot.focus_device pinned to the turn's focus candidates) and each ability's latest bot.ability.offers choices tagged with the ability's invoke id as target; the body routes a selection to its target, or to itself when the choice has none [floppy field].

target.description: The invoke id of the ability offering the event; absent for the body's own.

environment.description: The bot's environment this turn, from its own perspective, which the cognition passes to reasoning (its prompt renders it as the environment block) and intuition (in its decision instructions): the environment's id, and the bot itself, its state and its own attributes, owned_devices holding each held device it could read this turn under its reference (its reference, session id, state and data model, and the object it sits on), and firmware, the bot's firmware read the same way when its owner wrote one [floppy field].

id.description: The environment's id, its root session's _sessionid.

firmware.description: The bot's firmware, read this turn, when its owner wrote one: rendered as <firmware ref id state>, as a device is.

on.description: The id of the object the device sits on (a desk, a table, a shelf), when it rests on one.

participants.description: Who took part in the stimulus, stamped by the producer of this input. Empty when the producer knows no one (environment sound, routine tick).

items.description: Someone who took part in a stimulus: an opaque, producer-stable identity reference and the role it played (source: who produced it; target: who it was addressed to).

ref.description: Opaque, producer-stable identity such as a phone number, an app person id, or a chat handle. Never a display name chosen by the bot.
ref.title: Ref

role.description: source: who produced the stimulus (speaker, sender). target: who it was addressed to.
role.title: Role

own.description: True when the producer knows this participant is the bot itself, for example the bot's own voice heard back or the voice it spoke with. Stamped only by that producer; never inferred.
own.title: Own

resembles.description: For an identity its producer made just now (nobody it knew): the known identities it resembles, best first, at most 3. Stamped only by that producer; never a link.

items.description: A known identity this new one resembles: its ref and how similar the two are (-1..1). Perception data only: it links nothing, and it is never a print.

ref.description: The ref of the known identity, as its producer stamps it.
ref.title: Ref

similarity.description: How similar the two are, -1..1; higher is more alike.
similarity.title: Similarity

resembles.title: Resembles

items.title: Participant

participants.title: Participants
